c0-frame.title: Frame the cycle
c0-frame.imperative: Cycle 4: trial (human: 'lets do it!'). The real-issue dogfood: full f1Brainz map extracted and rendered per the ruled pipeline; one unblocked f1Brainz issue worked by a dev agent whose handoff carries the Map entry point per the new skill edits; regen-after-change runs as part of the same trial (the maintenance-loop test). Consumption value and loop viability are the two live unknowns this cycle probes.
c0-frame.finding: flavor=trial (human: 'lets do it!'). Cycle 4 = real-issue dogfood: full map + one unblocked issue + dev agent with map handoff + regen-after-change. Probes the two live unknowns: consumption value, maintenance-loop viability.

prep-fullmap.title: Prep: extract and render the full f1Brainz map
prep-fullmap.imperative: Run the ruled extractor (x7b AST pipeline) over all of f1Brainz src/ plus scripts/ and tests/ (closing the x11 extraction-window gap), run the supplement pass, render agent-lean per-entity pages with render_fn, and emit ids.jsonl. f1Brainz stays READ-ONLY for this step; artifacts land in evidence/x13/map/. Record entity/page/hole counts and wall time as finding.
prep-fullmap.finding: Full map BUILT: 1,224 files (1 BOM parse failure), 515,678 statements, 14,998 entities, 16,222 pages, 38s cold rebuild, deterministic (double-build diff clean), ASCII-clean templates, ids.jsonl established empty. Entry-point page verified: split_half_boundary_drift referenced-by = 3 sites / 3 modules, matches independent AST scan. DEFECT FIXED (D4): function-scoped imports dropped edges to local — 2,046 calls/reads lost across 315 files, including the trial's own entry-point call from pipeline.py; fixed in x13 copy. DEFECTS NAMED NOT FIXED: D2 contains-symbol truncates nesting chain (251 entities, 87 colliding definition sites — store cannot distinguish them; renderer joins on file+line, 14,998/14,998 resolved); D3 wrapped docstring summary renders split (cosmetic, inherited from x11). Resolution 9.26pct unresolved vs 7.55 on the slice (gentle at 180x; 95pct of it dispatch-unknown-base). SCALE FINDINGS: tests hold 61pct of entities and 85pct of test pages carry 'referenced by: none' (true but useless — a noise class needing a rendering policy); src orphan rate 13pct is now REAL signal (window closed); top INDEX at 1,233 lines is NOT a routing surface — needs a second grouping level; entity pages hold their size at scale (median 15 lines, p90 25).

prep-issue.title: Prep: pick one unblocked f1Brainz issue
prep-issue.imperative: Find f1Brainz's issue tracker; list unblocked issues; pick one bounded enough for a single dev-agent dispatch (human: 'pretty much any unblocked issue will do'). Record the pick and why as finding.
prep-issue.finding: PICK: f1Brainz #708 — split_half_boundary_drift (scripts/validate_segment_map_662.py:160) relies on a default telemetry-store path that fails confusingly in worktrees; fix = explicit store arg. WHY: unblocked, bounded (one function + callers), labeled low; and the task IS a blast-radius exercise — callers in src/physics/pilot/pipeline.py and tests/unit/physics/segment_map/derivation/test_segment_map_gating.py span src+scripts+tests, exactly the extraction window x11 flagged as missing and this cycle's full manifest closes. The map's referenced-by line for the function is the direct test of non-grep-recoverable value.

x13.title: Excursion: the dogfood trial — a dev agent works a real issue with the map
x13.imperative: Dispatch a dev agent on the picked issue, on a branch in f1Brainz (never its main). Handoff carries the Map entry point (specific pages for the issue's entities) per the new template pattern, plus the light implementer map-use guidance and the comment grammar (write tagged comments where the change embodies an assumption/constraint/rationale; mint [id] anchors only at need). Capture: whether/how the map was used (trace), whether pages carried non-recoverable facts or got skipped for grep, quality of the change, comments written. Record scoped verdict as finding; the human reads the diff.
x13.finding: Trial COMPLETE, fix landed: branch map-trial-708 @ 337f661f (f1Brainz worktree, not pushed), 3 files +77/-7, gating tests 7/7 (2 new). Agent found the REAL bug under #708: run_stage_c already carried telemetry_store and DROPPED it for the drift call — the confusing error was the symptom. Signature now keyword-only required store; cache fallback deliberately given up for this check (recorded as Rejected: comment). USE-TRACE (the measurement): 5 pages loaded — 2 clear wins (cross-module signature+semantics lookups: reference_lap_from_store, load_quali_session — cheapest available answer, multi-line signatures grep can't give), 1 mild win (entry point: x2 call multiplicity shaping the plumbing surface), 1 parity (own-module page vs reading the file), 1 worthless (top INDEX: 60 lines read, nothing learned — flat 235-module listing is not navigation). Map skipped for: value-origin question (DEFAULT_STORE_PATH is an ABSOLUTE one-machine path — found by grep; map is navigable by symbol, not by value/question), argument-flow question (carried-and-dropped is assignment structure, invisible to call edges), test guard constants, outside-window certainty. MAP DEFECT FOUND: referenced-by module list omits the DEFINING module (count said 3, names listed 2 — trusting names over count would have shipped a broken main); also nothing on the page says the count already excludes definition/import/docstring mentions (grep says 7, map says 3, reconciliation is manual). GRAMMAR FIRST CONTACT: 6 tagged comments written (4 Constraint, 1 Rejected, 1 Rationale), zero anchor ids (as predicted); gap found — no convention for function-scope tag placement. Workflow feedback: handoff should carry WHICH caller holds the value being plumbed; verification command needs absolute interpreter path. Verdict scoped: map pays on cross-module signature lookups, neutral own-module, blind to value-origin and argument-flow questions.

x14-regen.title: The maintenance-loop test — regen over the real change
x14-regen.imperative: After x13's change exists: re-run extraction + render over the changed f1Brainz branch, diff the derived store against the pre-change map, and assess: is the diff legible and bounded by the source churn (the minimal design's core claim)? Do any tagged comments written in x13 extract into statements? Does the empty-diff determinism assertion hold on a no-change rebuild? First-ever regen #2 — record everything that surprises as finding.
x14-regen.finding: REGEN #2 RAN — the maintenance loop works. Rebuild over the map-trial-708 branch: 38s-class again (8.2s extract, 1.8s supplement, 11.7s render). MAP DIFF: 38 of 16,222 files, 98 changed lines total vs the source diff's 84 (+77/-7) — churn ratio ~1.2x, confirming the minimal design's core claim (map churn bounded by source churn) with a measured number. LEGIBILITY: the entry-point page diff reads as a review artifact (signature change, new docstring contract, new call edge, referenced-by 3 to 5 picking up both new tests); the importer-side effect is ONE line (validate_segment_map_662 joins telemetry_store's imported-by — the fix's new import, visible from the other end). Untouched-entity churn is pure line-number shift (:132 to :133), one line per below-edit entity, confined to derived pages which are gitignored — the committed layer carries no positions per the ruled design. TAGGED COMMENTS: 0 extracted — as expected, the comment-extraction pass does NOT exist yet; 6 authored tags now sit in real source as its first test corpus. Named next build item. Determinism was proven at prep (double-build identical).

x15-merge.title: Merge map-trial-708 to f1Brainz main (human-authorized)
x15-merge.imperative: Human 2026-08-07: 'im not gonna review it... if its judged good its good and we can go ahead and send out an agent to merge it up to main in f1brainz.' Dispatch a merge agent: re-verify gating tests, push branch, PR with Closes #708, squash-merge via GitHub (local main checkout untouched), clean up worktree+branch. Record outcome.
x15-merge.finding: MERGED: PR #733 squash-merged as e3d6b542; issue #708 CLOSED; trial worktree+branch removed. THE MERGE GATE EARNED ITS KEEP: the PR as the dispatched agent left it was 179 files/+20,809 — the trial worktree had been branched from the human's LOCAL main (3cf79f78), one unpushed commit ahead of origin/main (6c3bd350), so it bundled his own docs(#724) archive round (176 files) with the fix; a squash-merge would have flattened his archive work into a bug-fix commit. Dev agent's own commit was clean as reported (3 files, +77/-7). Correction: stopped the stalled merge agent, rebased --onto origin/main (his local commit untouched and still unpushed), re-ran gating tests 7/7, reverted the test's side-effect on tracked data/f1_data_2023.db, force-with-lease pushed the trial branch only, waited for CI (arch-map/docs/pyright all pass), merged. PROCESS ITEM FOR DISPATCH TEMPLATES: cut trial branches from origin/<default>, never from the local default branch — an unpushed human commit underneath silently widens the PR. Merge agent stalled after PR creation without merging or reporting (dispatch-reliability datum, cause undiagnosed).

q8-test-coverage.title: Human direction: test noise discussion + explicit function-test coverage links
q8-test-coverage.imperative: Record the ruling conversation: is test-page noise a problem or byproduct; human wants explicit function-to-test links for direct coverage understanding.
q8-test-coverage.finding: HUMAN DIRECTION 2026-08-07: test-entity noise raised ('generates a bunch of useless stuff - problem or byproduct?'); wants the map to serve test-coverage evaluation, with EXPLICIT function-to-test links ('id actually like us to explicitly create links between functions and test files so we have an understanding of coverage directly'). AGENT ANALYSIS presented: the noise is a RENDERING byproduct, not an extraction problem — nobody navigates TO a test page, but extracting tests is precisely what enables the inverse projection: a src entity's 'tested by:' line = inbound calls filtered to tests.*, derivable from the store TODAY with zero new extraction (derived-views-never-stored doctrine). Proposed: stop rendering per-entity test pages (halves page count, module INDEX still lists them); split referenced-by into prod-callers vs test-callers (fixes the conflated orphan signal: 561 'no inbound' currently mixes unused with untested); emit a coverage report (src entities with zero inbound test edges, ranked by x4 call frequency). LIMITS NAMED: static direct-call reachability, not executed-line coverage — fixture/helper indirection lands on the helper (transitive closure approximates); 9.26pct unresolved hides some test-to-target edges; complements coverage.py, does not replace it. Authored links (See: tags) only where static resolution fails, per derivation-first.

consolidation.verdict: trial cycle complete — loop proven end to end, fix merged
consolidation.summary: Cycle 4 (trial): full f1Brainz map built (1,224 files, 15k entities, 16k pages, 38s cold, deterministic); real issue #708 fixed map-first from a Map entry point handoff (true bug found beneath the reported symptom); regen #2 measured map churn at 98 lines vs 84 source lines (~1.2x, bounded, legible); use-trace scoped the value honestly (pays on cross-module signature/semantics lookups, neutral own-module, blind to value-origin and argument-flow); grammar first contact wrote 6 real tagged comments, now merged to f1Brainz main via PR #733 (e3d6b542) with the merge gate catching a branch-base defect; human direction added the test-coverage projection (tested-by links); build queue ranked. Human called convergence.
